description: This source file defines command-line interface commands for managing a launchd agent on macOS. It includes commands for installing, uninstalling, and checking the status of a user launch agent, encapsulated as structs conforming to 'ParsableCommand'. It also contains a helper enum for handling plist file creation and removal.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Defines the root command 'service' with subcommands for managing launchd agents.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Implements the 'install' command to set up the launchd agent plist.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Implements the 'uninstall' command to remove the launchd agent plist.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Implements the 'status' command to check whether the launch agent plist exists.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes a plist file for the launchd agent with specified executable.

methods.name: removePlist
methods.description: Removes the plist file for the launchd agent.
